Why is the return code for enqueue-failure so different, why is this not a Result?

How is someone supposed to match ideomatically to check whether work was already submitted?
As seen on RawWorkItem, when the pointer type is an Arc or ARef the return type is a Result. But when it's a Box the operation cannot fail and therefore the return type is ().
You mean because the only possible error is "already enqueued", which cannot happen with box
